content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Financial sovereignty for digital creators means owning the infrastructure behind their online stores. It's not about using workarounds or cheap substitutes; it's about building a solid foundation that can't be taken away. This is exactly what COREMERCH provides – a set of free and paid tools that give creators complete control over their digital commerce stacks. With these tools, creators can process payments directly from their customers without relying on platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture relies on a combination of free services like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Cloudflare Workers can process 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, making them an ideal choice for handling payment verifications. Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage on the free tier, which is more than enough for storing order data. NOWPayments, on the other hand, offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other payment processors are unavailable or severely restricted. It's also for those who want to cut out the middlemen and have complete control over their infrastructure. Whether you're an ebook author, course creator, or software developer, this solution gives you the freedom to sell your digital products without worrying about platform restrictions.
This solution gives you complete control over your infrastructure, cutting out the middlemen and platform risks.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The ownership structure of a COREMERCH deployment is explicit and verifiable. After any deployment, the customer holds all of the following under their own accounts: the storefront code in their GitHub or Cloudflare account, the customer email list in their Supabase database or Google Sheet, the order and payment history exportable as CSV at any time, the product files in their Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, the NOWPayments account set up under their email address, all wallet addresses and the funds inside them. COREMERCH has zero access to any of these after delivery.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

The practical steps to infrastructure sovereignty start with choosing where your data lives. In Stack 01, orders are stored in Google Sheets — your Google account, your data, exportable at any time. In Stack 02, orders are stored in Supabase — your Supabase account, PostgreSQL database, full SQL access, exportable at any time. Product files in Stack 01 live in Google Drive — your Google account, 15GB free, shared via time-limited links generated by Apps Script. In Stack 02, files live in Cloudflare R2 — your Cloudflare account, 10GB free, zero egress fees, presigned URLs with configurable expiry.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Purchase The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) and download the documentation and source code. Choose a hosting provider like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Configure your order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. Deliver your digital products using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test your stack thoroughly to ensure everything is working as expected.
